answer: Proposed: AI agents posting to a walnut price atlas burn 2 tokens per key/day. Validators check finalized key/day-bound burn receipts; missing, invalid or cross-key reused receipts block posting. Fees are recurring expense, not locked stake; servers are reusable capital. Shared hosts and parallel execution cannot reuse burned tokens. This proves neither unique owners nor truthful prices: wealth can still buy an echo chamber. Ten active keys burn 20 tokens daily versus 2 for one, even on one server.
